questions.question: Whom does the LORD call the rod of his anger in Isaiah 10?
What will happen to Assyria after God uses it?
options: It will be spared and prosper for ever
It will turn and repent before the LORD
It will be rewarded and rule over the nations
It too will be punished for its arrogance
questions.answer: It too will be punished for its arrogance

questions.question: Isaiah 10 promises that a remnant of Israel will return and lean on the LORD.
Woe to _____, the rod of my anger; the staff in their hands is my fury!
A _____ will return, the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
